---
title: "Rewise on Start + Void"
description: "Native Rewise Worker profiles, the sealed cutover artifact, and the cutover and Vercel rollback packet."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

Rewise (`apps/rewise`) runs on TanStack Start, Vite+ and Void behind
[`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge). The Next.js build
(`build`) and the Vercel project stay in place until the cutover has been
stable, so the canonical host keeps a one-step route back.

## Worker profiles

| Profile | Selected by | Worker | `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Staging (default) | no profile variable | `tuturuuu-rewise-vite-staging` | `1` |
| Production | `VITE_REWISE_NATIVE_PROFILE=production` | `tuturuuu-rewise` | `0` |

Neither profile declares routes; `workers_dev` and `preview_urls` are off. The
only canonical host is `rewise.tuturuuu.com` (the retired `rewise.me` and
`rewise.school` origins are rejected). Any other host answers `404`.

A Worker missing any required secret or an abuse guard configuration,
refuses to serve (`cloudflare/required-secrets.ts`) instead of running on a
fallback. Names only are recorded here.

| Route | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | Redirects to `/login` |
| `/login` | Redirects to `https://tuturuuu.com/login` (central sign-in) |
| `/api/build-info` | Local build identity |

## Build and artifact

`rewise-cloudflare.yaml` has a `cutover-artifact` job that builds with
`VITE_REWISE_NATIVE_PROFILE=production`, seals the Worker, assets and emitted
Wrangler config with `scripts/ci/rewise-native-artifact.py`, records the
emitted configuration receipt, runs
`node --test cloudflare/anonymous-smoke.runtime.mjs` against the sealed output in
workerd with synthetic secrets only, and uploads
`rewise-cutover-production-<source SHA>`. It never deploys. Do not run
`build:cloudflare` on a shared development machine.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-rewise` |
| Route | `rewise.tuturuuu.com/*`, operator-attached |
| Static assets binding | `ASSETS` (`dist/client`, `run_worker_first`) |
| Build command | `VITE_REWISE_NATIVE_PROFILE=production bun run --cwd apps/rewise build:cloudflare` |
| Binding | `ABUSE_GUARD` → service `tuturuuu-abuse-guard` |
| Secrets (names) | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`, `ABUSE_GUARD_KEY_PEPPER` |
| Vars | `ABUSE_GUARD_FAMILIES=proxy`, optional `ABUSE_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://rewise.tuturuuu.com`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_APP_URL=https://tuturuuu.com` |
| Optional AI keys | the provider keys listed in `env.example`, as secrets on the Worker |
| Prior Vercel deployment | record the immutable deployment ID and URL of the `rewise` Vercel project before the switch |
| Data | no database writes and no migrations; reuse the existing Upstash database, provision nothing new |

### Switch

1. Record the source SHA, artifact name and Vercel deployment ID.
2. Provision the secrets and vars on `tuturuuu-rewise`, deploy the sealed
   output, and run the smoke below against the Worker's own address.
3. Attach `rewise.tuturuuu.com` (a proxied route in front of the still-valid
   Vercel origin where possible).

### Smoke

```bash
# Entry route redirects to /login; no 5xx
curl -sI https://rewise.tuturuuu.com/ | head -5
# Login redirects to the central sign-in page
curl -sI https://rewise.tuturuuu.com/login | head -5
# Build identity matches the accepted SHA
curl -s https://rewise.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
# Foreign host is refused
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Host: tuturuuu.com' https://rewise.tuturuuu.com/
```

Expected: a redirect to `/login`, a redirect to `https://tuturuuu.com/login`,
the accepted commit, and `404`.

### Rollback

- **Triggers:** 5xx above 1% for 5 minutes, a sign-in loop, a chat or AI route
  failing for authenticated users, or any cross-host response.
- **Action:** remove the Worker route (or repoint the mapping) so the host
  resolves to the recorded Vercel deployment. Never rebuild on the rollback path.
- **Data:** a route rollback changes no conversation data.
- **Stability:** keep the Vercel project and domain for 14 consecutive stable
  days before decommissioning, which is a separate approval.
